read.passage: My name is Sam. Today is Friday and my family is at the park. My dad is cooking on the barbecue and my sister is riding her bike. We often come here at the weekend. I usually play football, but today I'm flying my kite. Mum says, 'Could you help me with the picnic?' 'Of course!' I say.
